a no_std library crate, no app: nothing runs or draws
no renderer: draws no frame (its behaviour is a schedule, the world check's, not a picture)
no window or renderer: draws no frame
no window: the app runs its schedule once and draws no frame
the OS moving and resizing the window: window-manager-only
the OS window's scale factor: window-manager-only
the compositor showing through a transparent window: window-manager-only
the OS window's position and size saved between runs: window-manager-only
(a test) the OS resizing the window: window-manager-only
(a test) the OS minimizing the window: window-manager-only
(a test) the OS asking for redraws: window-manager-only
